## How to use this booklet

This booklet is a map of embroidery, one of the four Needle Arts on Curious Sparoows (with Crochet, Knitting and Sewing). Every entry tells you, in one or two lines, what a stitch, tool, tradition or style is. Every entry has an ID (such as EMB-05.1) that is also its address on the website.

- **Parts** are the big branches; **Sections** (EMB-01, EMB-02...) are the main topics.
- **Entries** carry a ☐ box: tick it when you have learned or made it.
- **Registers** give 24 style cards (region, stitches, GI year) and a history timeline.
- Start with **Part 0**, five two-minute questions.

**Step 3.** Pick one Indian tradition near you (Part 4).

Knowledge belongs to the artisans who created it. Motifs are described, never copied; makers and communities are credited. Where something could not be verified, we say so instead of guessing.
